source: ROUND-TRIP SYNTHETIC — sentences synthesised by the product's own server TTS (Piper vi/en/ko/zh/ru, Kokoro+misaki ja), transcribed by the product's own server STT (PhoWhisper-small vi, whisper-small others), scored against the reference text they were synthesised from. This is a FLOOR for comparing the two halves of the pipeline against each other, not a measurement of how a real guest's voice performs — see bench/asr-eval.ts and bench/README-speech-eval.md for what a human-recorded set would take.
